author: neatcleaver
body:
I can imagine it is quite difficult for lower tier players

Having AoE abilities is the best way to do it but I'm not sure what you have access to, unfortunately AoE is less common below tier 9/10

Things like collateral damage on warrior classes or mage spells that hit all targets for example. I've been doing it with Realmshifter with a weapon that has an AoE ability

As for how it works it seems to be somewhat random (keep in mind I am tier 10 so details may not be the same in lower tiers)

Enemies spawn and 1-4 new enemies appear per turn, and it's almost like multiple waves but it seems really random. I've done 2 turns of enemies and it's over and sometimes 6+ but eventually they do stop spawning then you go to the next stage

It's a bit odd but the enemies do eventually stop spawning

author: NotaRealVet
body:
I'm not entirely sure about the mechanics behind it, but if I don't kill the two mobs that are already there when I enter the dungeon, a handful more tend to spawn in. 

usually after killing like five to eight mobs the floor finishes and it lets me go to the next floor.

author: RainbowNarwhal13
body: So right around the 3 hour mark, after killing at least FIVE HUNDRED enemies, and *just* as I was about to give up, it FINALLY ended. Didn't even attempt floor 2, I'm genuinely shocked anyone has finished this insane dungeon. Really, really, horrible design, very disappointing and frustrating!
